category_specific_evidence: Commit changes default tanh JVP rule from (g + g*ans)*(1-ans) to g*((1+ans)*(1-ans)) so that jvp(-x)==jvp(x) and grad(-x)==grad(x) hold bit-for-bit
Rationale given: tanh(-x)==-tanh(x) and floating-point multiplication is commutative; evaluating (1+ans)*(1-ans) before scaling by g avoids premature rounding when g!=1
